calculationFlow: BARC India estimated TV reach for Pran Pratishtha live coverage: ~14 crore (live + same-day repeat).
OTT + YouTube live: ~5-7 crore (DD News YouTube alone had massive viewership).
Radio (AIR + private FM): not measurable but reach ~3-5 crore.
Public viewing (LED screens in cities, temples, communities): ~2-3 crore.
Total unique cumulative reach: ~20-25 crore Indians.
Concurrent peak (the actual prana pratishtha moment, ~12:30 PM): ~10-12 crore concurrent.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Concurrent peak (the actual prana pratishtha moment, ~12:30 PM): ~10-12 crore concurrent.
